item.title: Iqbal Singh Chahal denies visiting I-T dept after pictures of notice goes viral on social media
item.description: The notice is in circulation but I have not visited the I-T office even once. These notices come and get answered at appropriate lower levels, says Iqbal Singh Chahal

item.title: PIL in HC seeks implementation of child marriage prevention act
item.description: The petition has also sought formulation of a system to rescue such victims, cancel the marriages and take penal action against parents to stop this child marriage menace

item.title: Dongri resident arrested with MD worth ₹4.66 crore
item.description: After interrogating him a police team visited his residence and recovered 2.405 kilograms of the contraband material during his house search

item.title: Commuters point out to lack of progress in Metro line on Badlapur – Ghansoli - Kanjurmarg route
item.description: As the work of other Metro lines has commenced, the commuters from Badlapur and Dombivli cities have highlighted the requirement for expediting the implementation of Metro line 14 namely the Badlapur – Ghansoli - Kanjurmarg route; commuters from Badlapur, Ambernath, Kalyan and Dombivli have to either rely on Central and Harbour Railway lines or Roadways to commute to Navi Mumbai or Mumbai

item.title: Independent wet waste composting system gaining momentum in Navi Mumbai
item.description: Navi Mumbai Municipal Corporation is appealing to housing societies to set up independent composting units in order to reduce the garbage being carried to the landfill site and also lower the transportation cost of the garbage; as a result, more housing societies are accepting independent wet waste composting system

item.title: Council passes resolution to condemn Karnataka CM’s border issue remarks
item.description: The issue was raised by Shiv Sena legislator Diwakar Raote, who accused the Karnataka CM of spreading falsehood about the border issue

item.title: HC grants bail to Avantha Group promoter Gautam Thapar
item.description: According to the CBI, while working as the MD and CEO of Yes Bank, Rana Kapoor had connived with Gautam Thapar with an intention to extend undue financial benefits to M/s. Avantha Realty Ltd

item.title: Heavy security in and around Navi Mumbai’s DY Patil Stadium as IPL begins on Saturday
item.description: As the Indian Premier League (IPL) 2022 matches begin on Saturday, and with the first match in Navi Mumbai’s DY Patil Stadium to be held on Sunday, the Navi Mumbai police has tightened the security in and around the stadium; along with the police staff from Mumbai police, around 2,350 police officials would be around and inside the stadium conducting various security drills and trials from Saturday

item.title: HC to state: Give timeline for filling up vacant posts on Child Rights Commission
item.description: The court noted that the selection committee constituted for the purpose of selection of chairperson had given its recommendation however the final decision of the state government on appointment was yet to see the light of day

item.title: Biker dies in road accident after unknown vehicle knocks him from behind in Thane
item.description: A biker in his thirties working in HDFC Bank debt department in Parel dies after meeting with an accident along the bridge at Thane Kharegaon Toll Naka on Thursday

item.title: Fuel prices hiked by 84 paise a litre; petrol above ₹112 in Mumbai
item.description: MUMBAI: The petrol and diesel prices were hiked by 84 and 85 paise a litre respectively on Friday, the third increase in four days as oil firms recoup losses from holding rates during the period prior to the recently-concluded assembly elections

item.title: Fuel prices hiked by 84 paise a litre; petrol above ₹112 in Mumbai
item.description: MUMBAI: The petrol and diesel prices were hiked by 84 and 85 paise a litre respectively on Friday, the third increase in four days as oil firms recoup losses from holding rates during the period prior to the recently-concluded assembly elections

item.title: CIDCO meets civic officials to discuss water supply to various nodes in Navi
item.description: Following various complaints from the citizens of Navi Mumbai about interrupted water supply in various nodes, CIDCO conducted a meeting with NMMC, PCMC, MIDC and MJP to discuss the measures to be taken to ensure uninterrupted water supply to Kharghar, Taloja, Kamothe and Kalamboli nodes

item.title: ED attaches Sena MLA’s flats, land worth ₹11.35 cr in NSEL scam
item.description: In October 2013, ED had registered a money laundering case under the provisions of Prevention of Money Laundering, 2002, in connection with the NSEL fraud

item.title: TB loss to follow up rate drops to 1.4% in two years
item.description: In 2019, the rate came down to 5% (2,222) and further took a plunge to 4% (1,604) in 2020. The rate further dropped to 1.4% (716) in 2021

item.title: Uddhav Thackeray dares BJP to arrest him to come to power, says we never harassed your kin
item.description: Speaking at the Assembly, Maharashtra CM Uddhav Thackeray reportedly said, “If you want to come to power, then come to power. But don't do all these vicious things to come to power. Don't harass our or anyone else's family members. We never bothered your family members”

item.title: 3 Thane roads to turn into walk plazas in mornings from April 1
item.description: With a view to making safe walkways for morning walkers, Thane Traffic Police and the TMC are developing three morning walk plazas from April 1; one lane in each of the 3 roads – Mayor Bungalow to Payladevi Temple, Veer Birsamunda Road to Dr. Kashinath Ghanekar Road and Traffic Police Office in Teen Hath Naka to Dharamveer Anand Dighe Entrance – would be barricaded, beautified and dedicated only for morning walkers between 5.30am and 8am

item.title: Navi Mumbai civic body targets big property tax defaulters, threatens stern action
item.description: Navi Mumbai Municipal Corporation has begun cracking down on big property tax defaulters in the city who have not yet cleared the dues by taking advantage of the amnesty scheme of the civic body; it has issued notices to 299 such defaulters of a Turbhe commercial complex alone to pay or face stern action

item.title: Work on 3rd Patripool bridge in Kalyan delayed due to permissions: MSRDC
item.description: The work of the ongoing third Patripool bridge in Kalyan is delayed due to the delay in permissions for land acquisition, claimed the Maharashtra State Road Development Corporation; MSRDC will need permissions from railways and a housing society whose plots are affected in the construction of the third bridge

item.title: Ahead of final exams, fresh circular puts city schools in a fix
item.description: Mumbai: As city schools were gearing up to start final examinations for their students from batches 5 to 9, the school education department has released a circular stating a change in the academic and exam schedule

item.title: 40-chair plush dining car of iconic Deccan Queen is ready
item.description: New revamped dining car has been upgraded with a modular kitchen that railway authorities can use to prepare fresh meals for passengers.

item.title: BMC attempts to cut water supply to Metro
item.description: Even as the dispute between the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) and Mumbai Metro One Private Limited (MMOPL) continues over property tax, personnel from the civic body on Thursday visited multiple properties of the MMOPL in Andheri (W) including DN Nagar Metro Station to cut the water supply for non-payment of property taxes since 2013

item.title: Dharavi reports zero active Covid-19 cases for the first time in the pandemic
item.description: The Dharavi slum, which was one of Mumbai’s worst affected Covid-19 hotspots at the beginning of the pandemic, reported zero active cases on Thursday, for the first time since April 1, 2020, when the first case of the virus was reported from the slum

item.title: BMC requests NIV to send Covid-19 positive wastewater for genome sequencing
item.description: Experts said that unlike other respiratory viruses, RNA [ribonucleic acid] of SARS-CoV-2 and other coronaviruses can be detected in human faeces too.

item.title: MVA ‘surprised’ as SC transfers Param Bir Singh case to CBI
item.description: Sachin Sawant, Maharashtra Congress general secretary, asked if the supreme court’s order meant that the State police was not credible while the CBI was impartial.

item.title: ‘An effort to…’: Sanjay Raut on CBI taking over probe of ex-Mumbai top cop Param Bir Singh
item.description: As many as five cases of extortion and corruption have been lodged against former Mumbai Police commissioner Param Bir Singh. Earlier in the day, the Supreme Court said that it hopes the CBI to conduct an “impartial inquiry” into all aspects of the charges levelled against Singh.

item.title: BJP alleges irregularities in Covid-19 centre contracts allotted by BMC
item.description: Devendra Fadnavis also hit out at Shiv Sena over the corruption in the BMC and the income tax raids against Yashwant Jadhav who has been facing charges of amassing disproportionate assets.

item.title: Maha records 139 new Covid-19 cases, 3 deaths; active tally below 1,000
item.description: With this, the tally of Covid-19 cases in the state rose to 78,72,956, while the death toll increased to 1,43,772, a heath department bulletin said.

item.title: CBI court orders immediate transfer of Dheeraj Wadhawan to JJ Hospital
item.description: A complaint was received by the court from Taloja jail authorities that Wadhawan was admitted to the private hospital since April 6, 2021, and he was avoiding prison.

item.title: MPCB tests Thane creek for pollution, says water not polluted
item.description: Following the claims of the greens regarding pollution in Thane creek leading to death of fishes, MPCB conducted a survey of the creek on Thursday; it claimed that the creek water had no foul stench or dead fishes and is not as polluted as the greens claimed

item.title: Underground parking facility below Gaondevi Maiden in Thane to be ready by early May: TMC
item.description: The first underground parking facility below the historic Gaondevi Maidan near Thane station will be open by early May, informed TMC officials; the facility will provide parking space for more than 250 vehicles, easing congestion near the Thane station premises caused due to lack of parking space

item.title: Adharwadi dumping ground in Kalyan catches fire; brought under control
item.description: Adharwadi dumping ground in Kalyan caught fire on Thursday evening leading to thick smoke covering the nearby areas; a total of five fire tenders from the Kalyan-Dombivli Municipal Corporation (KDMC) fire department rushed to the spot and initiated fire-fighting operations

item.title: Former state home minister Anil Deshmukh moves HC for bail
item.description: The application states that the allegations have not been corroborated by the agency even after the passage of substantial time since he was detained and hence he should be granted bail.

item.title: Raigad district officers visit Odisha for training to handle cyclone
item.description: A team of 50 officers from various departments of Raigad district have been sent to Bhubaneshwar in Odisha to undergo special training to handle cyclone and flood situations; Odisha State Disaster Management Authority has taken precautionary and risk mitigation measures in the wake of floods and cyclones affecting their State every year and is experienced in preparing for cyclones on the East Coast of the country, said Raigad Collector, Mahendra Kalyankar

item.title: 19th witness turns hostile in 2008 Malegaon blast case
item.description: During his testimony, the witness had complained that then Maharashtra Anti-Terrorism Squad (ATS) chief Hemant Karkare had threatened to implicate him in the case if he failed to name certain people.

item.title: In a setback for Zee, Bombay HC allows investors’ plea for EGM
item.description: The division bench of justice SJ Kathawalla and justice Milind Jadhav has, however, continued the restraint for three weeks to enable Zee Entertainment Enterprises to move the Supreme Court.

item.title: Not named in enquiry report, FIR: Suspended DCP Saurabh Tripathi tells court
item.description: “I was nowhere named in the crime till last week,” Tripathi’s counsel, advocate Aniket Nikam, submitted while seeking anticipatory bail for the suspended IPS officer.

item.title: Owner of Mumbai’s popular restaurant chain receives ₹2 crore extortion call
item.description: Mumbai: Restaurant chain Persian Darbar has filed a police complaint after an unknown caller demanded ₹2 crore from them and threatened to trouble them, if the demand was not met

item.title: Man arrested for assaulting traffic police in Ulhasnagar
item.description: A 52-year-old traffic constable who was trying to resolve a fight in Ulhasnagar was injured after a person involved in the fight assaulted him; Ulhasnagar police have booked a person and arrested him for attacking the constable and getting involved in a fight in middle of a road

item.title: Assembly passes bill to set up special courts for speedy trial of crimes against women, children
item.description: Dilip Walse Patil, state home minister, tabled the bill Maharashtra Exclusive Special Courts (for certain offences against women and children under Shakti Law) 2020 in both Houses of the legislature.

item.title: Taloja residents facing severe water problems since last July
item.description: Residents of Kedar Housing Society at Sector 21, Marwa Housing Society at Sector 22, Dhanashree Housing Society at Sector 37 and Asawari Housing Society at Sector 27 in Taloja that had started receiving possession from July 2021 under various low income housing schemes are now dependent on tankers as they are facing water problems

item.title: SC orders transfer of all cases against Param Bir Singh to CBI, asks Maharashtra govt to complete process within a week
item.description: Former Mumbai Police commissioner have five cases of extortion and corruption lodged against him. He had been absconding for six months before finally showing up in November last year - once on November 25 before the police and again on November 29 before a judicial commission.

item.title: Bill passed to make Marathi mandatory in official works
item.description: While backing the bill, BJP legislator Yogesh Sagar taunted the Shiv Sena-led government, saying it remembered Marathi language ahead of civic body polls in several cities including Mumbai, Thane and Navi Mumbai

item.title: Civic body to beautify three major lakes in Kalyan
item.description: Kalyan Dombivli Municipal Corporation (KDMC) has undertaken to beautify and revamp three naturally-existing lakes in the city; the recent incident of the death of hundreds of turtles at the Gauripada Lake in Kalyan, however, has raised concerns over this revamping

item.title: KDMC sets up eye donation facility at Rukmini Bai Hospital in Kalyan
item.description: The Kalyan Dombivli Municipal Corporation has set up a 24x7 eye donation facility at one of its civic-run hospitals, the Rukmini Bai Hospital; apart from donation, the hospital also has counsellors to guide the families of the deceased and address their concerns; officials claim that 3 donations have been carried out

item.title: 11-yr-old girl sexually assaulted in Pune school. Officials say he was an outsider
item.description: Pune’s senior inspector at Shivajinagar police station Anita More said the 11-year-old girl told her friends about the sexual assault in the school premises

item.title: Fire breaks out in Byculla residential building, no injuries reported
item.description: The Mumbai Fire Brigade (MFB) officials informed that the fire started on the third floor of the Vitthal Niwas Building around 12.15 pm

item.title: Fuel prices rise by 80 paise for second consecutive day in Mumbai, now at ₹111.67
item.description: The last time a litre of petrol crossed ₹111.67 in the city was on October 15, 2021 while a litre of diesel touched ₹95.79 on June 25, 2021

item.title: Shiv Sena will fight injustice: CM Thackeray tells legislators
item.description: Mumbai: In response to the Enforcement Directorate’s action against his brother-in-law Shridhar Patankar, Shiv Sena chief and Maharashtra chief minister Uddhav Thackeray on Wednesday told party legislators that the party would fight injustice meted out by the Centre

item.title: Three-member committee report rules out possibility of MSRTC, state govt merger
item.description: The action taken on the report will be tabled in the lower house soon to announce that the merger of the MSRTC with the government was not possible

item.title: ED intensifies hunt for hawala operator linked to CM’s brother-in-law
item.description: ED has claimed that Chaturvedi, through his shell company, parked unaccounted money in the real estate projects of Shree Saibaba Grihanirmiti Pvt Ltd

item.title: BMC to appoint new agency to fine ‘mask-less’ offenders in public
item.description: Mumbai: City’s clean-up marshals who were assigned the dedicated task of penalising people for not wearing face masks in public during the pandemic will now move to their routine work of fining citizens who litter in public, spit, defecate in the open, and pet owners whose pets litter on the streets too

item.title: HC grants ₹1L ad-hoc compensation for fisherfolk
item.description: The Bombay high court (HC) has granted ₹1 lakh as ad-hoc compensation for over 900 fisherfolk affected by the new three-lane Thane creek bridge, to be paid out of the deposit of ₹10 crore

item.title: BEST driver, conductor save 5-year-old’s life, offer to pay for his treatment
item.description: BEST bus conductor Appasaheb Lohar and bus driver Kishore Dane took the child Shivam Parker, who was travelling with his mother Pooja Parker, to the hospital

item.title: ‘ED action on Uddhav Thackeray’s relative leaves no room for BJP-Sena reunion’
item.description: The BJP, through the central agencies, had been closing in on Sena chief Uddhav Thackeray, who had junked the alliance due to a dispute over sharing of the chief minister’s post in November 2019.

item.title: Man arrested for robbery in Thane residential complex pretended to be food delivery boy
item.description: Man arrested in a robbery at a plush residential complex in Thane is not a food delivery agent but was merely pretending to be one, claimed the Naupada Police a week after the robbery; the 19-year-old accused, Abhishek Dede, was working with a food delivery service for two months last year and was no longer an employee but still had the uniform

item.title: MCAP: PM2.5 and PM10 levels have fallen since 2015
item.description: Another air quality report indicates average particulate matter levels increased between 2019 and 2021 in Mumbai, but fell in 2020 when Covid-related restrictions were in place
